title: Usage accounting auditability playbook for billing, quotas, and rate limiting
creator: Alice Park
description: Create a reproducible, auditable playbook and implementation tasks to ensure billing/metering, rate limiting, quota consumption, and usage accounting are provably correct and produce SOC-ready evidence. This ticket covers immutable event capture, access controls for audit data, retention policy, reconciliation pipelines, signed ledgers for accounting snapshots, and a artifacts checklist for external auditors.
background: Recent internal reviews flagged gaps in how usage events and quota enforcement actions are recorded and retained for long-term audits. Current logs are spread across request logs, rate-limiter caches, and billing batches which makes constructing a tamper-evident history difficult. We need an engineering playbook that defines the canonical sources, storage guarantees, and evidence artifacts (dashboards, signed reports, reconciliation outputs) auditors expect.
acceptance_criteria: Production path for recording every metering-relevant event (generate, embed, quota-check, rate-limit decision) into an append-only store with immutable timestamps and cryptographic signing

Retention policy documented and implemented: primary retention 3 years for day-to-day audits, cold storage 7 years for compliance with enterprise customers; automated retention enforcement with no manual deletions
RBAC controls and access logs for audit datastore and evidence bundles: only compliance and SRE groups can export signed bundles, all exports recorded in SIEM
Reconciliation job that compares ingestion counts to billing batches with nightly alerts on variance > 0.1% with an explainable root cause
Prepared SOC evidence package template (confluence + signed ledger export + reconciliation report + access log snapshot) that maps to auditor questions
End-to-end test harness that simulates rate-limit/quota events and verifies recorded events appear in the audit store with intact signatures and correct metadata
tasks: Design append-only audit event schema and signing flow (Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/BILLING/Audit+Event+Schema)
Prototype append-only store: Kafka topic -> S3 immutable objects with object-level MD5 + manifest signing (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/2468)
Implement KMS-based signing routine for daily ledger manifests and per-batch signatures (ticket: ENG-8401)
Add RBAC enforcement and export audit trail in Console: UI flag + backend check; log exports to Splunk (dashboards linked below)
Build reconciliation pipeline: ingest billing batches and compare to aggregated meter events; store results in BigQuery and surface flakiness alerts
Create SOC evidence template in Confluence and checklist for Shipping to auditors
Write unit+integration tests for signing verification, retention TTL enforcement, and export authorization
Run tabletop audit dry-run with Compliance and one enterprise customer; iterate on evidence format
decisions: Use Kafka as the ingestion buffer and immutable S3 objects for long-term storage to balance write throughput and cost
Daily manifests will be signed using KMS asymmetric keys; manifests plus object hashes provide tamper-evidence
Retention default policy: 3 years hot, 7 years cold; legal/compliance can request longer per-customer via exceptions list
Exports require two-person approval in Console and generate an immutable export record in SIEM
Reconciliation jobs run nightly with a strict SLA: finish within 2 hours of run start; anomalies open P0 incident if variance > 0.5% and unresolved in 4 hours
